# Town of Cavendish municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 5; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Cavendish Selectboard members: Shannon Devereux, Robert Glidden (Chairman), David Norton, Michael Ripley, and Sandra Russo.

Town of Cavendish official website, Boards and Committees page: lists the same five Selectboard members (the site prints 'Robert W. Glidden' and 'Mike Ripley'). The page also states the Water Commissioners are appointed by the Selectboard and that the Selectboard sits as the Board of Sewer Commissioners, so no separate utility posts are created.
Town of Cavendish official website, Town Office page: 'Michael Murphy, Town Clerk and Treasurer.'

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Diane McNamara as Town Clerk of Cavendish and as Town Treasurer of Cavendish; she did not stand for re-election in 2026, and the town's current page governs.
Town of Cavendish official website, Town Office page: 'Michael Murphy, Town Clerk and Treasurer.'

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Diane McNamara as Town Clerk of Cavendish and as Town Treasurer of Cavendish; she did not stand for re-election in 2026, and the town's current page governs.

Town of Cavendish, 2022 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the town's elected offices include the Town Moderator. Michael Ripley was the incumbent going into the 2026 election. Structure only: the seat stood for election in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome.

Town of Cavendish, 2022 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the town's elected offices include the Town Agent. The office was reported vacant going into the 2026 election. Structure only: the seat stood for election in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome.

Town of Cavendish, 2022 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the town's elected offices include the Auditors (three seats). Andrew Amatutz held the one-year seat going into the 2026 election; the two-year and three-year seats were reported vacant. Structure only: the seat stood for election in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome.

Town of Cavendish, 2022 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the town's elected offices include the Town Grand Juror. Theresa McNamara was the incumbent going into the 2026 election. Structure only: the seat stood for election in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome.

Town of Cavendish, 2022 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the town's elected offices include the Library Trustees (five seats). Christopher Saylor's five-year seat stood for election in 2026. Structure only: the seat stood for election in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome.

Town of Cavendish, 2022 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the town's elected offices include the Trustees of Public Funds. The seat warned in 2026 was reported vacant. Structure only: the seat stood for election in March 2026 and no official source publishes the outcome.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Cavendish justices of the peace: Doris Jameson Eddy, Maureen Savage, Christopher Saylor, John Smart, and Rolf van Schaik. John Smart is the listing's form; the town's older tables print Jack Smart.

The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
